name: M-6NK
description: M-6NK, nicknamed Monk, was a bartender droid who worked at Pyloon's Saloon on the planet Koboh as the business partner of the Latero Greez Dritus. Monk was known for keeping a close eye on the patrons of the saloon and for his extensive knowledge of beverages.

data.name: M-6NK"Monk"
equipment: A small tank filled with alcoholic beverage
